titulo: Secant friction angle φ′s (°) of the waste rock of the example, median / 5th percentile of the mean envelope
nota: Laboratory: specimen void ratio and size. Placed: void ratio 0.65 (rock type E, 0.80), maximum particle size 1 m, size effect with zero mean. The full-correlation case sorts the samples of each rock type at every stress, an upper bound on dependence. No site tests above σ′n ≈ 4.6 MPa. The critical surfaces of Table 4 of the paper mobilize σ′n of up to about 2 MPa.
